dominant_strengths: Strong heroic headline scale with confident sans-serif sets a clear devtools-for-AI tone and brand voice
Restrained black canvas with prismatic light-leak motif gives a moody, premium developer aesthetic
Logo wall is monochromed cleanly, preserving hierarchy without competing with the headline
dominant_weaknesses: Severe vertical rhythm break: hero headline is clipped at top while a giant gap sits below before the next section
Secondary 'Postgres for the AI Engineering era' block uses oversized gray-on-black body copy that reads as low-contrast filler, not a section
Left-rail sub-nav (AI, Autoscaling…) floats orphaned with no visual anchor or active state, breaking scannability
fix_priorities: Re-anchor scroll position and pad hero so the H1 is fully visible with intentional whitespace below
Tighten the AI section: shrink the gray paragraph, raise contrast, and pair it with the side-rail as a coherent two-column module
Give the left navigation a clear active indicator, consistent indent, and section heading so it reads as a TOC
Unify the prismatic light element with section transitions instead of letting it die at the fold
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral impression is decent thanks to the dark prismatic hero, but behavioral clarity collapses mid-scroll and reflective payoff is muted by generic AI-era copy.
rationale.intent_fit: It reads as a credible Postgres/devtools landing page but the scroll-500 frame exposes layout seams rather than showcasing a polished narrative.
